notes: Hex Dominion - A complete turn-based hex strategy game with AI opponent. Features: 4 hand-crafted scenarios + procedural generation, 6 unit types with unique abilities, 4 structure types, fog of war, territory control, resource economy, save/load system, undo, tutorial, 4 AI difficulty levels using minimax with alpha-beta pruning and MCTS for expert, full keyboard/mouse controls, accessibility options (high contrast, color blind, reduced motion, large UI), procedural audio synthesis, animated combat/movement, particle effects. All assets generated in code - no external dependencies except Google Fonts.
